name: Core i7-1195G7
memory: DDR4-3200, LPDDR4X-4267, dual-channel, up to 64 GB

passmark.mapping_note: CPU: exact entry 'Intel Core i7-1195G7 @ 2.90GHz'. GPU: PassMark pools every 'Intel Iris Xe' iGPU (80 and 96 EU, many chips) under one entry; there is no per-SKU entry.

notes: igpu.cu counts the 96 EU as 6 subslices of 16 EU (the Xe-LP equivalent of an Xe-core). Tiger Lake has no hybrid cores and no NPU (ARK lists none; the 'with IPU' SKU name refers to the image processing unit). tdp_w: default 28 W from TPU; min and max are ARK's cTDP-down 12 W and cTDP-up 28 W. base_ghz is the 28 W base from TPU. launch_date from TPU; ARK says Q2'21. igpu.tflops_fp32 = shaders x 2 FLOP x vendor max GPU clock (single-issue FMA; RDNA 3 dual-issue is not counted). PassMark scores mix TDPs and host devices; treat them as a rough guide only.
